description: Given the slugs you intend to put on ONE page, returns: rule violations (hard, invalidate the page), warnings, the measured budget (JS gzip / assets / scroll corridor), and an ordered init plan — single Lenis instance, CustomEase registration, entry veil first, one ScrollTrigger.refresh() at the end, WebGL loop gating. Every step cites the evidence it comes from.

moving_sections.description: Las secciones que DEBEN moverse (plan_page → motion_coverage.must_move), o cuántas son. Con esto el contrato audita la cobertura y te dice si te has quedado corto.
